Welcome to Pixelogic

Quick overview. For a complete tab and sub-section manual, open the Help tab from the sidebar.

Pixel Designer

  • Define the real-world size (m/ft/cm), panel size and resolution.
  • Calculated metrics show both reduced and decimal aspect ratios, for example 5:4 (1.25:1).
  • Choose a visual style (checker/gradient), border and numbering.
  • Enable/disable individual panels by clicking in the preview.
  • Duplicate pixel maps to try variations quickly.

Map Annotations

  • Overlay info, markers (circle, cross, corners), and corner circles.
  • Include Metrics adds screen size, pixel size and both aspect-ratio formats to the centre badge.
  • Add a logo, color bars, and adjust shared color/thickness.
  • Coordinates overlay shows (X, Y) top-right with adjustable size.
  • Live preview with zoom/fitting; thumbnails for quick switching.

2D Visualizer

  • View the selected Pixel Map at full pixel resolution.
  • Fit, zoom, and export the layout image if needed.

Output Canvas

  • Compose multiple pixel maps into a single output canvas.
  • Multi-select maps with Ctrl/Shift, then drag as a group.
  • Delete selected maps (Delete/Backspace); undo/redo with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y.
  • Crop by panels, draw annotations, and view fluorescent canvas bounds.
  • Export PNG/JPG; use the Transparent PNG toggle for alpha exports.
  • Scrollbars appear when the canvas is larger than the viewport.

LED Patching

  • Configure wall and tile specifications on the left, inspect the live patch diagram in the centre, and review processor, port, and circuit allocation on the right.
  • Use Auto Patch for Snake/ZigZag routing, or Draw Lines to build signal and power paths tile-by-tile.
  • In Draw Lines mode, click or drag through orthogonally adjacent tiles. A tile can belong to only one route of the active type.
  • Use Next Port to finish a data line and advance from C1-P1 onward; power drawing advances to the next circuit.
  • The dock beneath the wall shows active assignment, tile count, pixels or amps, live load percentage, and overload status.
  • Undo/Redo edits, Clear All to wipe the active manual layer, then Undo if the clear was accidental. Select Done to leave drawing mode.
  • Toggle Data and Power overlays, use FIT or zoom controls, then export PNG or the professional 2-page PDF report.

AV Schematics

  • Node-based AV signal flow schematic builder with 50+ devices and 14 signal types.
  • 20 pre-built templates (LED wall, projection, broadcast, streaming, corporate AV, worship, and more) with category filtering.
  • Canvas settings: background colour, grid style, snap-to-grid, minimap. Undo/Redo (Ctrl+Z).
  • Dark / Light PDF export, Rack Elevation View, CSV Import, Document Info, and Connection Hover Labels.
  • Export as PNG or multi-page PDF with Cable Color Reference page.

PDF Export

  • Render a spec sheet with title, details, delivery specs and preview.
  • Map auto-fitting controls let you position the preview precisely.
  • Fill the Title Block (project, venue, client, version).
  • Typography supports Windows system fonts (fallback to PDF core fonts).
  • Step sections are collapsible to reduce clutter.
  • File Delivery Spec: Edit opens the form; Save closes it.
  • Include Pixel Pitch in Details; auto-computes from panel size/res if missing.
  • Pixel-map details include total pixel size and aspect ratio in PDF and PPTX exports.

Power Calc

  • 65 tile models across 10 brands with real bench-measured Amp values at 100% and 50% brightness.
  • Per-scenario breakdown: Full Red, Green, Blue, White and Standby — per tile, total and per phase.
  • 1-Phase or 3-Phase mode with automatic tile distribution across L1/L2/L3.
  • Recommended breaker size calculated at 1.25× safety factor for each scenario.
  • Summary KPIs: total A, active power (kW), apparent power (kVA at PF 0.9), worst-case breaker per phase.
  • Export a professional dark-theme PDF report with summary KPIs, scenario breakdown, phase distribution and reference data tables.

Projects

  • Manage projects (rename, delete, mark saved) and reopen later.
  • New and saved projects are shown side by side.

Circular LED

  • Plan curved/circular LED screens with diameter/radius metrics.
  • Preview ring modules, circumference, and measurement helpers.

Misc Tools (Aspect Ratio + LTC)

  • Aspect Ratio Calculator: preset and custom aspect calculations with visual reference.
  • LTC Generator: create SMPTE LTC WAV files with configurable frame rate, sample rate, and bit depth.

3D Visualizer

  • Interactive 3D textured model of every project map with orbit, pan, zoom and per-map transforms.
  • Each screen has a boxed label with map name, physical W × H and pixel resolution.
  • Add stage decks, select Move and drag a deck directly, or use Span to LED Bottom to align and match width.
  • Stage callouts clearly show deck name and W × D × H dimensions.
  • Toggle UV overlay, depth grid, X/Y/Z axes and extrude depth while editing.
  • Camera Views: save named camera angles, recall with one click, delete individually or Clear All.
  • Auto Revolve mode for hands-free presentations; adjustable spin speed.
  • Save PNG/JPG exports a clean full-resolution snapshot without editor axes or transform gizmos.

Projector Test Pattern

  • Generate projector alignment patterns, including dome mode.
  • Adjust overlaps, hatching, grid, numbers, and unit settings.
  • Sub-tabs: Settings, Flat Calculator, Curved Calculator, Circular/Dome Calculator.

Typical Workflow

  1. Create or open a project in the Projects tab.
  2. In Pixel Designer, set physical size, LED panel details, and style.
  3. Refine overlays in Map Annotations.
  4. Send to Output Canvas to compose multi-map layouts.
  5. Plan signal distribution in LED Patching; build signal chain in AV Schematics.
  6. Calculate power requirements in Power Calc before site day.
  7. Export PNGs or generate a PDF spec in PDF Export.

Tip: Use the duplicate buttons in Pixel Designer and Output Maps to iterate without losing your original.
